quandoUsar: An app's command palette: search and run actions, go to other pages, or change settings without taking your hands off the keyboard.
Up to a few hundred actions with groups, icons, and visible shortcuts, where search accepts abbreviations (“dup pr” finds “Duplicate project”).
Quick search embedded in a page or panel, since the component is an ordinary panel, not a modal.
quandoEvitar: Use `combobox` when the person chooses a value for a form field, not an action.
Use `search-field` or `expanding-search` to search content with results specific to the page.
Avoid with thousands of items or server-side search: filtering runs on the client on every keystroke over the whole list and all results are rendered.

teclado.acao: Move the highlight between results, in the order they appear, and stop at the first and last.
Move the highlight to the first or last result (in the field, they do not move the text cursor).
Runs the highlighted result (after typing, the first one); the search is cleared and focus stays in the field.
Clears the search; with the field already empty, calls `onClose`.
Anywhere on the page, move focus to the field while the palette is mounted.

acessibilidade: The field is a `combobox` tied to the list (`role="listbox"`) by `aria-controls`, and the active result goes in `aria-activedescendant`: focus never leaves the field.
Groups are `role="group"` with the group name, each result is an `option` with `aria-selected`, and an `aria-live` region announces the total number of results or “No results”.
`label` becomes the field's hidden label; the component does not trap focus or cover the page, so to use it as a modal, put it in a `dialog` that returns focus on close.
movimento: A single highlight slides on a fast spring to the active result, by pointer or arrow keys, and the results frame follows the list height when filtering.
When typing, the rows that leave fade out and the remaining ones slide to their new place; if the new order moves any row more than six positions, the list switches all at once.
With “reduce motion” on, the entrance, highlight, height, and rows change instantly, with no slide or fade.
responsivo: The list has a maximum height of 342px and scrolls inside, bringing the active result into view; in windows up to 480px, the shortcut keys and the “⌘ K” hint disappear.
desempenho: Search scores all items on every keystroke and each result is a button with a layout animation; a `ResizeObserver` measures the list so the frame follows the height.
notasIA: Although it is among the blocks, it installs at `@/components/ryan-ui/command-palette/command-palette`; pass `items` with `id` and `label` and, optionally, `group`, `keywords`, `description`, `icon`, and `shortcut`.

It does not open or close by itself: for a modal, mount it in a `dialog` when the shortcut is pressed, with `autoFocus`, and close it in `onClose`, called by Esc with the field empty and by the “Esc” button.
`shortcut` only draws the keys on the row, without registering a shortcut; the only real shortcut is the global Ctrl+K/⌘+K, which focuses the field and may collide with one of your own.
